question: What is the average total quantity across all final packaging combinations, considering only the leaf-level items within each combination after fully expanding any nested packaging relationships?
sql:
-- Now compute the average total quantity across all final packaging combinations.
WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
    SELECT 
        p.id AS root_id,
        p.name AS root_name,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        pr.qty AS level_qty,
        pr.qty * 1.0 AS cumulative_qty
    FROM packaging p
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON p.id = pr.packaging_id
    WHERE p.id IN (
        SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations
        EXCEPT
        SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations
    )
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        pt.root_id,
        pt.root_name,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        pr.qty AS level_qty,
        pt.cumulative_qty * pr.qty AS cumulative_qty
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pt.current_id = pr.packaging_id
),
leaf_items AS (
    SELECT 
        pt.root_id,
        pt.root_name,
        pt.current_id AS leaf_id,
        SUM(pt.cumulative_qty) AS total_leaf_qty
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    WHERE pt.current_id NOT IN (SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
    GROUP BY pt.root_id, pt.root_name, pt.current_id
),
root_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        root_id,
        root_name,
        SUM(total_leaf_qty) AS grand_total_qty
    FROM leaf_items
    GROUP BY root_id, root_name
)
SELECT AVG(grand_total_qty) AS avg_total_quantity
FROM root_totals

{"sql": "-- Now I need to fully expand each root packaging combination to find all leaf-level items.
-- For each root, I need to trace down the hierarchy, multiplying quantities at each level,
-- and sum up the leaf quantities.

-- Let me trace the hierarchy from each root to leaves:

--    So 531 contains 12 * 72 = 864 bottles of 502

-- 532 (Pallet of M) -> 522 (Box Medium, qty=20) -> 501 (Bottle 330cl, qty=36)
--    So 532 contains 20 * 36 = 720 bottles of 501

-- 533 (Pallet Mix MS) -> 522 (Box Medium, qty=10) -> 501 (Bottle 330cl, qty=36)
--                    -> 523 (Box Small, qty=20) -> 502 (Bottle 500cl, qty=30)
--    So 533 contains 10*36=360 bottles of 501, and 20*30=600 bottles of 502

--                     -> 524 (Gift Box, qty=16) -> 511 (Gift Carton, qty=8) -> 501 (qty=3), 502 (qty=2)
--    So 534 contains 20*30=600 bottles of 502
--    And 534 contains 16*8*3=384 bottles of 501, and 16*8*2=256 bottles of 502
--    Total for 534: 384 bottles of 501, 600+256=856 bottles of 502

WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
    -- Start with roots
    SELECT 
        p.id AS root_id,
        p.name AS root_name,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        pr.qty AS level_qty,

{"sql": "-- Good, now I need to filter to only leaf-level items (items that don't contain anything else).
-- Then for each root (final packaging combination), sum up the cumulative quantities of leaves.
-- Then compute the average across all final packaging combinations.

WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
    -- Start with roots
    SELECT 
        p.id AS root_id,
        p.name AS root_name,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        pr.qty AS level_qty,
        pr.qty * 1.0 AS cumulative_qty
    FROM packaging p
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON p.id = pr.packaging_id
    WHERE p.id IN (
        SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations
        EXCEPT
        SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations
    )
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recurse deeper
    SELECT 
        pt.root_id,
        pt.root_name,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        pr.qty AS level_qty,
        pt.cumulative_qty * pr.qty AS cumulative_qty
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pt.current_id = pr.packaging_id
),
-- Filter to only leaf items (items that are NOT packaging_id in packaging_relations)
leaf_items AS (
    SELECT 
        pt.root_id,
        pt.root_name,
        pt.current_id AS leaf_id,
        SUM(pt.cumulative_qty) AS total_leaf_qty
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    WHERE pt.current_id NOT IN (SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
    GROUP BY pt.root_id, pt.root_name, pt.current_id
)
SELECT * FROM leaf_items ORDER BY root_id, leaf_id", "preview_rows": 20}

        p.name AS root_name,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        pr.qty AS level_qty,
        pr.qty * 1.0 AS cumulative_qty
    FROM packaging p
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON p.id = pr.packaging_id
    WHERE p.id IN (
        SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations
        EXCEPT
        SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations
    )
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        pt.root_id,
        pt.root_name,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        pr.qty AS level_qty,
        pt.cumulative_qty * pr.qty AS cumulative_qty
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pt.current_id = pr.packaging_id
),
leaf_items AS (
    SELECT 
        pt.root_id,
        pt.root_name,
        pt.current_id AS leaf_id,
        SUM(pt.cumulative_qty) AS total_leaf_qty
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    WHERE pt.current_id NOT IN (SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
    GROUP BY pt.root_id, pt.root_name, pt.current_id
),
root_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        root_id,
        root_name,
        SUM(total_leaf_qty) AS grand_total_qty

    GROUP BY root_id, root_name
)

    root_name,
    grand_total_qty
FROM root_totals
